proof_audit.reasoning: Consistency and no interference define own-cohort outcomes. An unaffected target baseline and clean controls allow adding/subtracting the target untreated change to separate ATT and counterfactual trend bias. Conditional equality within finite baseline cells is integrated over the target cohort distribution.
proof_audit.boundary: Random sampling is not random adoption, observed pretrends do not verify future counterfactual trends, and control eligibility/observation support are substantive.

proof_audit.topic: True normalized odds and DR remainder
proof_audit.reasoning: Conditional expectation gives E[(1−A)p/(1−p)]=pi and its weighted conditional-outcome mean. For finite candidate functions the common-pi functional has remainder E[(p−ptilde)(m0−mtilde)/(1−ptilde)]/pi by one exact conditional algebra expansion.
proof_audit.boundary: Either correctly specified nuisance cancels the population remainder. Both terms use actual treated share pi, not an arbitrary normalization of misspecified odds. No generic nuisance-learning inference follows.

proof_audit.reasoning: The joint cell counts and change totals are fixed-dimensional iid averages with finite second moments. Positive cell probabilities make the ratio map smooth. Derivatives of target cell shares, target means and control means give three stated contributions; their sum is phi. Plug-in squared influence is consistent by finite-cell laws for counts, changes and squared changes.
proof_audit.boundary: Estimated target-cell composition contributes uncertainty. Return unavailable for any empty group/cell; a fixed auxiliary value on the exponentially unlikely exceptional event supports the limit sequence only. Divide V by N; positive V needed for studentization.

proof_audit.topic: TWFE finite FWL and effect weights
proof_audit.reasoning: Residualizing treatment against normalized group/date effects gives beta=Dtilde prime Y/(Dtilde prime Dtilde). Balanced demeaning supplies the exact residuals. Under additive untreated means, only treated cell effects remain, weighted by Dtilde/den. Dtilde prime D=den proves weights sum to one.
proof_audit.boundary: Projection does not ensure nonnegative treated weights or causal validity under arbitrary untreated paths. Effect interpretation uses the stipulated additive untreated model and no anticipation.

proof_audit.reasoning: The four comparison expressions have coefficient vectors whose fixed weights3/10,3/10,1/5,1/5 sum to the full12-cell FWL operator. Equality of all basis coefficients proves the finite identity for every outcome table in this design.
proof_audit.boundary: Only the equal-mass three-cohort/four-date design is proved. Positive comparison weights still subtract a changing already-treated effect; no general all-design Bacon proof is claimed.

proof_audit.reasoning: The full12×11 design contains three group indicators, three normalized date indicators and every observed relative-time category except−1. Independent full-design inversion equals the5-column residual route. Residual Gram A/12 has determinant1/54; all60 operator entries and their action on fixed-effect/event columns are checked.
proof_audit.boundary: Impact zero is included. Contamination coefficients require exactly this set of columns and normalization; no unspecified binning or arbitrary event-design equivalence. Finite mean-table algebra is distinct from statistical inference.

proof_audit.reasoning: Clean never-treated comparisons identify each supported cohort-date effect. Nonnegative cohort weights define the target explicitly. At impact both E/L appear, while eventone has only E; holding E fixed changes the question. A constant-effect-per-cohort transfer isolates composition from dynamics.
proof_audit.boundary: Unobserved L eventone is omitted from support, not imputed zero. Cohort-specific identification assumptions remain necessary.

proof_audit.reasoning: Known horizon a means outcomes unaffected only at s<g−a. Baseline g−a−1 and control first adoption>t+a make both compared dates unaffected. Counterexamples separately contaminate the target baseline and the not-yet-adopted control.
proof_audit.boundary: Observed nonadoption through T is weaker than knowing G>T+a. Missing baselines, always-treated groups and late unsupported comparisons are not identified as zero.

proof_audit.topic: Pretrend nonidentification and sharp compact fibers
proof_audit.reasoning: Reduced form b=tau+delta with normalized baseline and zero preeffects fixes pre departures but not post ones. Two counterfactual worlds produce identical zero pre gaps and post gap4 with effects4/1. Nonempty compact convex departure fibers have continuous-linear images that attain bounds and fill an interval. For each allowed path, explicit untreated/treated potential means reproduce all observations.
proof_audit.boundary: Closed convexity alone is not a general endpoint-attainment theorem. Empty fibers are incompatible restrictions; no additional outcome or sign bounds are silently imposed.

proof_audit.reasoning: Relative post increments u,v lie in a compact square and target5−u−v/2 has radius3Mbar/2. Smoothness deviations e0,e1 give departure increments1+e0 and1+e0+e1 and target7/2−3e0/2−e1/2 with radius2M. Every vertex and an interior sharpness witness are reconstructed.
proof_audit.boundary: Relative magnitude is dimensionless relative to preincrement size; curvature is stated for unit-spaced periods. M0 permits a linear nonparallel departure, unlike the relative Mbar0 restriction.

proof_audit.reasoning: Known normal marginal scales give coordinate failurealpha/2 at z=Phi inverse(1−alpha/4); union bound covers both means with probability>=1−alpha regardless of correlation. The true admissible pair is then in the projected set. Compatible triples form a nonempty compact set; fixed preendpoint witness proves the interval directly despite lack of general joint convexity.
proof_audit.boundary: Preperiod uncertainty is included. Symbolic endpoints define the proof; printed decimals are approximations. This is not arbitrary DID normality, a generic clustered limit, bootstrap, ARP or RR uniform-asymptotic procedure.

refinements.resolution: Explicitly separate normalized true odds from the common actual-pi working DR functional; avoids attaching its product remainder to a differently normalized misspecified estimator.
Confidence compatibility triples are nonempty compact but need not be convex. Direct fixed-preendpoint witness proves the interval; no false joint-convexity assumption.
Sensitivity periods explicitly unit-spaced; successor label corrected to canonical Regression discontinuity and synthetic controls.
One literal answer anchor sought twelve although the solution displayed the complete12-cell vector. Changed it to the actual FWL operator wording; no arithmetic or solution changed.
Normal quantile helper explicitly rejects an alpha whose floating confidence level rounds to one; optimized mode exercises that boundary.
